scripts.audit: npm run audit:npm && npm run audit:maven
scripts.audit:maven: cd backend && ./mvnw org.cyclonedx:cyclonedx-maven-plugin:2.9.3:makeBom -DoutputFormat=json -DincludeTestScope=true -Dcyclonedx.skipAttach=true && cd .. && docker run --rm -v "${PWD}/backend/target/bom.json:/bom.json:ro" ghcr.io/google/osv-scanner:v2.4.0@sha256:5116601dedc01c1c580eb92371883ec052fc4c13c3fbc109d621a63ac416d475 scan source -L /bom.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run audit && npm run sast && npm run test
scripts.check:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run format:check && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm run check:compose && npm run test:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run openspec -- doctor
